title: Workout milestone reward
description: Celebrate a member's visit milestone and give a perk. Loyalty reward WhatsApp template for fitness studios. Free to copy and edit.
notes: Use the real visit count so it feels personal. Pair it with a small, concrete perk.

body.text: Amazing, {{first_name}}! You've hit *{{points}} workouts* at Acme Fitness. As a thank you, enjoy a free {{reward}} at the front desk.
